core_obligations: Preserve characteristic zero and explicit multilinear VNP family with Theta(n) variables and degree, Omega(n^2.5/log^6 n) wires and Omega(n^1.5/log^4 n) gates.
Complete projected shifted-partial measure operations and upper-bound grouping argument, all Claim8/9 proof continuations.
Complete both affine-projection heavy-gate pruning greedy procedures, support set-cover/probability and Claims11/13/Subclaim18 proofs.
Complete hard polynomial/NW choice and exact parameters; complete final main proof and AppendixC Claim17 factorial/binomial inequalities.
difficulty_reason: Combines a tailored projected shifted-partial measure with affine pruning of heavy gates, a selected NW hard family, and full parameter comparison to obtain the general depth-four wire bound.
